usageNotes: Use this to permanently remove a Proxmox access group that is no longer needed. The group must exist; deleting a non-existent group returns an error. Removing a group immediately revokes all ACL entries assigned to that group across all nodes and resources — member users lose any privileges they held solely through this group.
destructiveReason: Permanently deletes the group and removes all associated ACL assignments, which may immediately revoke resource access for every user who was a member of this group.
tips: Check group membership and ACL assignments before deleting (use get_access_groups_groupid) to understand the access impact.
There is no soft-delete or recycle bin — deletion is immediate and irreversible.
API tokens with the Group.Allocate privilege on /access/groups can perform this operation.
